mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.role_code
SELECT DISTINCT rm.menu_id FROM sys_role_menu rm JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id AND r.status = 1 JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT rp.permission_id FROM sys_role_permission rp JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id AND r.status = 1 JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id, parent_id AS parentId, menu_type AS menuType, route_name AS routeName, route_path AS routePath, component, redirect_path AS redirectPath, auth_code AS authCode, title_key AS titleKey, icon, sort_order AS sortOrder, route_meta AS routeMeta FROM sys_menu WHERE status = 1
SELECT id, permission_code AS permissionCode FROM sys_permission WHERE status = 1
